name: How to Play Piano: The Basics
instructions: Learn the natural note names (A through G) repeating up the keyboard, and how the two-and-three black key groups help you find them.
Practice finding C, D, and E with your right hand without looking down, using the black key groups as landmarks.
Play each note slowly with a relaxed hand, listening closely to the tone you produce.
Watch today's video for a full beginner piano lesson.
